text.title: FreshDrop, supermarket to delivery, Moscow, Aug 2026
text.t1: after a long queue at the shop on a Saturday
text.t2: read reviews of delivery services during the evening
text.t3: a friend recommended a delivery service with a fixed slot
text.t4: compared three apps, checked slot times and the price of delivery
text.t6: chose FreshDrop for the fixed slot and the reminder
text.t7: first weekly order went well; the courier was on time; expectations matched
text.push: waiting in queues on Saturday cost 2 hours a week
text.pull: a fixed slot and a reminder before the courier comes
text.anxiety: fear the courier will be late and the food will not arrive in time
text.habit: the family is used to shopping on the way home from work
text.insights: the job is a dinner on time for the family; the slot is what buyers pay for
text.decision: build the reminder and the slot guarantee; check it by the share of weekly orders
